title: 75th Ranger Regiment
description: Elite US Army light infantry unit
extract: The 75th Ranger Regiment, also known as the Army Rangers, is the United States Army Special Operations Command's premier light infantry direct-action force. The 75th Ranger Regiment is also part of Joint Special Operations Command via the Regimental Reconnaissance Company (RRC). The regiment is headquartered at Fort Benning, Georgia, and comprises a regimental headquarters company, a military intelligence battalion, a special troops battalion, and three Ranger battalions.
